name.description: What people call it: one line of 1 to 100 characters, with no space at either end.

description.description: What it is, in 1 to 2,000 characters.

name.description: What the field is called: words, not an id, one line of 1 to 100 characters. It stands once in its record.

description.description: What it holds, in 1 to 300 characters.

items.description: One thing a data record holds: a name and, if wanted, a description. It has no type.

fields.description: What it holds: a list of at least one field, each with a `name` that stands once.

description: A thing with a name that one part passes to another: what is sent, what comes back, what is put into a store or taken from it. It is no schema.
